author: Y Combinator
description:
Robot foundation models are starting to transfer skills from one machine to another, which means the bottleneck is shifting to hardware.

The U.S. still imports much of its robots and their critical components. We want to see founders rebuild that supply chain here, from magnets, motors, gears, and sensors to chips, batteries, and the machines that make them.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: Robots Made In America

author: Y Combinator
description:
Starship could make access to orbit orders of magnitude cheaper and more abundant.

That changes which space businesses are possible. Companies that don’t make sense at today’s launch costs could become viable when sending mass to orbit gets 100x cheaper. The time to start building for that world is now.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: Startups in a World of Abundant Space Access
